meta.note: The enhanced (ARPA/IRA) premium tax credit subsidies expired 12/31/2025. Under current law the 400% FPL subsidy CLIFF is live for coverage year 2026 (H.R. 5145 passed the House 1/8/2026 but is NOT enacted). MAGI_ACA = AGI + tax-exempt interest + non-taxable Social Security + excluded foreign earned income. 2026 coverage uses the 2025 HHS poverty guidelines (48 contiguous states + DC).

premiumTaxCreditCliff.secondarySource: CRS R48290; H.R. 5145 (119th Congress) — not enacted as of 2026-08-19
premiumTaxCreditCliff.cliffBehavior: At MAGI_ACA <= 400.00% FPL the premium tax credit is available; at 400.01% FPL the credit drops to $0.
premiumTaxCreditCliff.watchItem: H.R. 5145 is live legislation. Enactment of a subsidy extension is a rules-file version bump, not a code change.

povertyGuidelines2025.note: 48 contiguous states and DC. Used for 2026 coverage-year credit eligibility. Alaska and Hawaii have separate guidelines (not modeled in Phase 0 fixtures).
